reviewer: early_windows_review; not author of HeldFile/Win32 repair (author of earlier unchanged PE resource parser)
scope: Only the a65a6f Windows held-file repair delta against d332 original; static read, official ABI/ownership documents, one new owned-file/mock-Win32 extent control. Not whole-product or actual Windows acceptance.
decision: Changes requested: bind full-file hash traversal to the accepted extent before calling the repaired reader ready for actual CI. Other selected repair boundaries show no blocking finding.

findings.title: Use the admitted file extent for both hashes
findings.evidence: Windows initialization accepts self.size from FileStandardInfo but hash() still iterates earlier self.initial.st_size. There is no equality check between them. The controlled new-file model accepts native size 6 and reads six bytes while hashing only earlier diagnostic size 3; changing the final three bytes does not fail finish.
findings.minimalFix: Iterate and chunk self.size in hash() (POSIX already sets self.size=self.initial.st_size), or reject any length disagreement before hashing. Keep full native identity pre/post checks, size bound and final hash equality. Add a targeted old-stat/native-size disagreement control, including final-suffix mutation rejection.
findings.qualification: This establishes an unchecked accepted-extent/hash-span invariant. The model is not an actual Windows race; CreateFile FILE_SHARE_READ excludes data-write access and existing writable mappings, so no claim of normal NTFS concurrent-write reproduction.

reviewedBoundaries: CreateFileW GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT only; no create/truncate/delete/write or Backup/Restore privilege path. Directory and final reparse results reject.

Original Win32 handle is transferred once to CRT fd. Failed transfer closes original handle; constructor errors close fd. Temporary path fd closes in finally, and finish closes original fd on identity/hash failure as well as success.

FileIdInfo class18: 64-bit volume plus full128-bit identifier. Basic class0 uses four signed64 timestamps and DWORD attrs. Standard class1 uses two signed64 lengths, DWORD links, two BOOLEAN bytes. Native alignment expected24/40/24; inspected C layouts and ctypes types agree. This is static ABI review, not Windows invocation.

Same API supplies both held and path-reopened identity/metadata. Query failure or unavailable identifier rejects without fallback. Full id, volume, size, links, creation, write, change, attrs, delete/directory are compared before and after final hash.
LastAccess is excluded as intended because reads can change it. Attribute/EA access is not barred by share flags; metadata checks are observations, not a claim of atomic filesystem freezing.
Python stat/ctime fields are diagnostics only for identity. Old actual failure did not record Python version/compared tuples, so original differing field remains unknown.
Observations have16-entry bound,128-char basename and fixed primitive metadata fields, no file bodies/SD/credentials. Native query types/fields remain distinguishable from Python diagnostics.
